fixed_controls.harness: Fleet native SkyRL exact-version task-tool runtime

purpose: No-submit queue behind the exact prod4 reward-acquisition canary.

research_basis.inference: Use 1e-6 as the anchor and bracket it geometrically at 3e-7 and 3e-6; retain one native update per fresh batch.
research_basis.observed: DeepSeekMath reports GRPO policy learning rate 1e-6, 64 samples per question, KL coefficient 0.04, and one update per exploration stage.
research_basis.transfer_warning: The paper studies a 7B math model with 1,024-token answers, not a 27B tool-using cyber agent with long episodes.

research_basis.inference: Screen the anchor and learning-rate boundaries for ten updates before spending fifty updates on the retained anchor treatment.
research_basis.observed: Hyperband allocates a small resource budget broadly and increases the budget only for candidates retained by successive halving.
research_basis.transfer_warning: This queue uses a predeclared staged design, not the complete Hyperband algorithm, and Fleet task success rather than training loss selects arms.

successive_halving.dose50_extra_gate: a1 must have finite metrics, valid rewards, a reloadable step-10 checkpoint, and no development regression large enough to stop the arm
selection_inputs: finite loss, KL, entropy, and gradient/update telemetry
